mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <50% of instances during monetary easing cycles, or the 20d returns are not significantly higher than a baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 5% signals labor market weakness, reducing investor confidence and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns despite UNRATE crossing above 5%, or the 5d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high demand growth (GDPC1) and shrinking supply (INDPRO) create upward pressure on asset prices, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 exceeds 16,727 (previous 6-month value) and INDPRO drops below 103.8589 (previous 2-month value) in the last month
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive over 60d despite the demand-supply imbalance, or the 60d returns fail to outperform a baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate during a late-cycle expansion amplifies accommodative monetary policy, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns in late-cycle expansions with FEDFUNDS <1.0% are not significantly higher than other periods, or the 20d returns are not statistically different from baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) and deflationary pressures (CPIAUCSL < 240) create conflicting signals, reducing market confidence and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1.0% and CPIAUCSL < 240 in the last month
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative despite the dual signal, or the 20d returns are not statistically different from baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in monthly payrolls (PAYEMS) above 150,000 indicates robust labor demand, boosting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive despite PAYEMS exceeding 150,000, or the 5d returns fail to outperform a baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in supply (INDPRO < 100) signals weak business activity, reducing growth prospects and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative despite INDPRO falling below 100, or the 5d returns are not statistically different from baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high demand growth (GDPC1) and robust labor demand (PAYEMS) create a virtuous cycle, driving up asset prices and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 16,727 and PAYEMS > 145,303 in the last month
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive despite the dual demand surge, or the 60d returns fail to outperform a baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
